input.brief: La caseta del sabor, raspados mexicanos, intro de sabores que se convierte en hero

direction.name: The object, large
direction.idea: Show the thing, bigger than seems reasonable. One photographed object fills the first screen, scaled until the viewport crops it, with the text small and tucked beside or behind it. The crop is the idea: a record whose edge leaves the top-right corner, a bottle whose shoulder runs off the bottom, a chair seen so close you read its grain. Being that close reads as confidence in the object. Everything else on the page serves it: details as tight close-ups, facts as short lines, one way to buy.
direction.composition: First screen: the object occupies 55–75% of the viewport and breaks at least one edge. It sits on a flat field (ground colour or one bold colour), never in a box. The headline is short and either very large and partly hidden behind the object (10–13vw, the object overlapping two or three letters) or small (28–36px) in the opposite corner with a one-line description. No navigation bar beyond a wordmark and one action. Following sections: a row of three or four close-up details at different crop ratios (not equal tiles), a single wide photograph of the object in use, a plain list of facts set large (materials, size, price) aligned to one edge, then the purchase action. The object returns once at the end from a different angle.
direction.typography: Either very large and structural or very small and precise; pick one for the headline and hold it. Facts are set in the text face at 22–28px, not in a table.
direction.colour: A flat field chosen to make the object's own colour sing (its complement, or a tone darker than its shadow side). One field for the whole page, or a second for the facts section.
direction.imagery: Use the product's own photographs if they exist. Otherwise use a still-life from the dealt set as a stand-in and say so. Prefer images with a plain background; use `mix-blend-mode: multiply` on light fields so a white studio background disappears into the page colour.
direction.photoTreatment: Scale the main image well past its container (`width: 120–160%`) and let `overflow: hidden` on the section do the cropping.
direction.richness: The object's surface at close range, and the tension of the crop.
direction.pitfalls: A small centred product shot with space all round is a catalogue thumbnail, not this direction. If the image has a busy background it cannot sit on a field; crop tighter or change image. Keep text off the object's focal area.

hero.name: Anchored text, specimen half
hero.blueprint: The viewport is split exactly in half by two flat tones that meet at a clean vertical edge: the ground on the left, a palette colour on the right. Left half: the wordmark sits top-left on a 40px margin; the next two thirds of the height are empty; everything else is anchored bottom-left and ends 40px above the bottom edge: a headline on one or two lines at clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 40px), medium weight; one sentence at 18px in the soft ink, max 38ch; the single action as a solid rectangle. Right half: position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh. In its centre sits a square tile in a second palette colour, 450px wide (31vw) with a 24px radius, holding one cut-out item at 70% of the tile, object-fit: contain, mix-blend-mode: multiply on light fills. Under the tile's left corner the item's name and one fact sit at 15px. As the left column scrolls through the catalogue, the tile's item and colour swap to match the entry in view. One text link sits top-right on the colour field.
hero.mobile: The colour half comes first as a block 52svh tall holding the square tile at 62vw, centred, and stays sticky while the text slides over its lower edge. The text block follows on the ground: the headline at 7vw on two lines, the sentence at 16px, the action full width. The wordmark and one link sit on the top row over the colour.
hero.headline: A modest 3-6 word line at 28-40px, at most 40 characters; the object, not the type, carries the screen.

type.note: One neo-grotesk doing everything: semibold headings pulled tight, small regular text, no capitals and no second voice. Suits software, hardware and studio pages that want to look exact and unshowy.

palette.name: Putty and black
palette.note: Warm putty covers the page and pure black handles all type and the main shapes. The only tint in the interface is teal, used for the one button or a single marker placed near the photographs.

photos.title: Interior and table
photos.note: rooms, windows, chairs, cups, food and tabletops
photos.treatment: Scale the main image well past its container (`width: 120–160%`) and let `overflow: hidden` on the section do the cropping.

motion.name: Pinned story
motion.description: One element holds its place with `position: sticky` (a title, a frame, a product fragment) while the items that belong to it scroll past or swap inside it. The page's ordinary scrolling does the work; nothing is hijacked. Hold it for about one screen per step and three screens at most, two held stages per page at most, with a line of text on every held screen. Recipe: 'Pinned story' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Two objects, two fields
sections.blueprint: Two panels side by side, each 50vw wide and 92svh tall, in two different flat tones from the palette, meeting on a clean vertical edge with no gap. Each panel is dominated by one cut-out object photograph scaled to 130–150% of the panel's width and positioned so the panel's top edge crops it: the reader sees the lower two-thirds of the object, very close. On light panels use mix-blend-mode: multiply to lose a white studio background. Along the bottom of each panel, 28px in from the edges, one row: the name at 20px medium and a price or fact at 17px on the left; on the right, two small rectangular actions, one filled with ink and one with paper. Nothing sits in the middle of a panel. The heading, two to four words at 32–40px, is set at the top-left of the first panel only, in the empty corner beside the object.
sections.mobile: Panels stack, each 78svh tall, the object scaled to 150% of the width and cut by the top and right edges. The bottom row becomes two lines: name and fact, then the two actions side by side at full width. The heading sits top-left on the first panel at 26px.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: The object returns
sections.blueprint: The thing shown in the hero comes back once, from another angle, to close the page. On one flat field 90svh tall, the object's photograph occupies columns 1–8, scaled to about 130% of that area and anchored so the section's bottom and left edges crop it (`overflow: hidden` on the section; on light fields `mix-blend-mode: multiply` removes a white studio background). The text sits small in columns 10–12, vertically centred: a closing line of three to five words at 32–40px, one sentence at 17px, the price or key fact on its own line at 22px, and one rectangular button. Nothing overlaps the object's focal area. Where the page's subject is a shape rather than a photograph, the page's motif takes the object's place at the same scale as a flat filled shape. The closing line is the only heading.
sections.mobile: The text block comes first: closing line at 28px, sentence, fact, full-width button. The object follows at 130% of the screen width, shifted so the right and bottom edges crop it, filling about 55svh on the same flat field.

sections.name: Small frames, wide space
sections.blueprint: A flat, quiet viewport 100svh tall in which about 70% of the screen is empty. At mid-height a single row of small portrait frames runs across and off both sides: each frame 11vw wide and 24svh tall (roughly 2:3), spaced 5vw apart, vertically centred, six or seven visible at 1440. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border. The row scrolls sideways by drag or trackpad (`overflow-x: auto` with the scrollbar hidden) and may hold 12–24 frames. One line of text overlaps the top-left of the first frame by 12px: a title of two or three words at 20–24px followed by the count, placed above the frame in the stacking order. Hovering a frame scales it to 1.1 from its centre over 250ms; nothing else moves. No captions under frames, no arrows, and no other text in the section.
sections.mobile: The row sits at 45% of an 80svh section. Frames are 34vw wide at 2:3 and 5vw apart, so two and a half are visible and the row scrolls by touch with snapping. The title line sits 20px above the row at the left margin.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

sections.name: Photograph half, menu half
sections.blueprint: A split footer one viewport tall. The left half is a single photograph filling columns 1–6 edge to edge, cropped hard by the left and bottom viewport edges: a close crop of the page's main subject, larger than it appeared anywhere above. The right half, on a flat field, is the site's menu set large: five or six section names stacked as links at about 2.6vw bold, 28px apart, starting at column 8 and 80px from the top. Rows are separated by space only; on hover a row's label shifts right by 12px and the others drop to the softer ink. Under the menu, 64px lower, two short blocks at 15px side by side: contact and social. The legal line runs along the very bottom of the right half at 12px. The wordmark sits small at the top of the right half, on the menu's left edge.
sections.mobile: The photograph leads at full width and 50svh, cropped tight. The menu follows on the flat field at 8vw per item with 20px between items, then contact and social stacked at 15px, then the legal line at 12px. The wordmark sits small above the menu.

references.name: starboy
references.idea: A tiny gadget shown enormous: product renders so large the screen crops them, wrapped around a nursery-rhyme headline in fat lowercase.
references.hero: No nav, logo or button. Off-white ground. The right half holds the headline: five stacked lines of very bold rounded lowercase at 13vw (187px), right-aligned and almost touching the right edge, with tight negative tracking and leading under 0.9, so the stack runs from 5% below the top to past the fold and the last line's descenders are cut off. The left 60% is one transparent-shelled, star-shaped device rendered at huge scale (yellow circuit board, round black screen), rotated and cropped by the top, left and bottom edges, its right-hand points tucking behind the letters. A chrome keyring loop peeks in at bottom-right.
references.type: Milling Triplex 1mm, bold, for the headline at 187px in lowercase with -0.055em tracking, one or two words per line over eleven lines; the same family at about 13px for body copy, product names and footer links, all lowercase. Two sizes only, a 14:1 jump.
references.colour: #f9f9f9 #2a2b2d #f5d900 #8d8e96 #b8a45c #2f6fe0 — Off-white page with charcoal type. Colour lives in the objects: circuit-board yellow, chrome, matte black, brass. A small blue logo in the footer is the only interface colour.
references.imagery: Photoreal renders of star-shaped devices in four materials, cut out with no background or cast shadow, scaled well beyond the viewport, each rotated differently and cropped by the edges. Accessories are shown small and centred in grid cells.
references.layout: Three acts: three screens of oversized renders tumbling diagonally with the headline set right, then left; one screen holding a single narrow text column and nothing else; then a three-column hairline-divided product grid running edge to edge with no outer margin.

sections.description: The second and third screens are only renders: a matte-black star and a chrome star overlap on a diagonal, each wider than half the viewport and cropped by two edges. The second half of the headline then appears left-aligned at the same 13vw, left of centre, while a brass star fills the right half and bleeds off the top and right. No captions or interface.

A single column of 13px lowercase text about 290px wide, placed roughly 15% from the left and starting at the top of the viewport: five short paragraphs, the first in medium weight. The remaining three-quarters of the screen is blank off-white. No heading, image or button accompanies it.

Three equal columns span the full viewport width, separated by faint 1px vertical and horizontal lines. Each cell holds one cut-out render centred with generous air and a caption row along its bottom edge: product name at left, price with stock count or a coming-soon note in grey at right, all 13px lowercase. The footer is one row: small blue logo left, five text links right.

steal: Scale the product until two or three viewport edges crop it, and let its silhouette tuck behind the headline letters.
Break a sentence into one or two words per line at 13vw, right-aligned for the first half and left-aligned for the second, so the headline spans several screens.
Follow a loud hero with one tiny text column on an otherwise empty screen; the drop in scale does the pacing.

references.name: Moto Finance
references.idea: A metal card presented like a museum piece: lit by a single overhead light box in a black room, then orbiting through dim architectural stills.
references.hero: Black full-bleed 3D scene. A pale silver-lavender light panel, a trapezoid in perspective like a ceiling light box, occupies the top 20% and centre 55% of the viewport. The two-line uppercase headline, centred at 4.4vw in medium grotesk with tight leading, straddles the panel's lower edge so its first line sits half on light, half on black. In the exact centre a small metal card stands on a low plinth, only about 150px wide, surrounded by darkness. A light-grey pill button (about 250 by 52px) is centred near the bottom; the logo is top-left and a dark pill button top-right.
references.type: Neue Montreal only: weight 500 uppercase at 64px (4.4vw) with near-zero tracking and leading under 1.0 for headings, 20px sentence case for body, tiny caps labels in the footer. Three sizes; centred until the left-aligned footer.
references.colour: #080808 #edefef #c4cbd6 #e1e5e5 #2a2f3a — Black with cool silver-grey and no brand colour at all. One section inverts to pale grey-white with grey type; the only chroma is amber city lights and a blue atmosphere rim on the globe.
references.imagery: Rendered chrome card with an embossed profile medallion, a night-side Earth, and small dim architectural and fashion stills floating as tilted panels in 3D. Everything underexposed, cool and low-saturation.
references.layout: Full-viewport scenes stacked one per screen, each with a centred uppercase heading, an optional short sub-line and a pill button. One light interlude breaks the black. The footer switches to a left-aligned statement with link columns at the far right.

sections.description: Centred heading at the top with a two-line grey sub-line and a pale pill button directly under it. The lower 45% is the top arc of a night-side Earth rising from the bottom edge, about 75% of the viewport wide, with city lights and a bright blue-white rim on the upper right. Three small dark capsule labels with check icons float over and beside the globe at staggered positions, like status notifications.

A dark 3D room: about twelve small photo panels (roughly 70 by 90px, each tilted at its own angle, heavily dimmed) arranged in two loose rows across the full width, receding with blur. The card stands edge-on in the centre, much larger, catching a specular highlight. Later the card faces front at top-centre and a centred two-line heading with a pill button sits under it.

A pale grey-white band. Two tall columns of currency amounts in mid-size light-grey sans, one at a quarter and one at three-quarters of the width, each fading to white at top and bottom like slot-machine reels, with the centre rows darkest. Between them, three short centred lines of small black text. The bottom edge of the band reveals a dark photograph.

steal: Let a headline straddle the edge of a light shape so one line is half on light and half on dark.
Show the product very small in a large dark space in the first viewport, then let it grow as the page scrolls.
Use vertically scrolling columns of real-looking figures, faded at both ends, as a quiet backdrop for a three-line statement.
references.media: An 11s hero video of a CG metal card on a plinth covers the whole first screen and holds on its last frame. Then a pinned WebGL globe in the lower half under centred text, a 3D card centred in a depth cloud of small photo tiles dimmed to 30-40%, full-bleed sticky photographs with text docked in opposite corners, and a photo strip sitting on an index list; all low-key and desaturated, photos meeting the near-black ground through 200-300px fades, 0px radius.
references.motion: The intro ends in about 1.2s as the camera pushes in and the headline, nav and button arrive (load 9.9s), and Lenis then runs 32 ScrollTriggers: the globe pins for 2.5 viewports at scrub 1, the card turns in 3D across its section, the theme inverts to pale grey with the nav colour following, and benefit rows scrub in one by one. Lines rise by yPercent over 0.65s power3.out and leave over 0.45s power2.in, and headings rise from a blur over 1s power2.inOut.

references.name: Madie
references.idea: A burgundy-and-cream bakery brand in which the madeleines themselves, cut out like specimens, become the menu.
references.hero: A dark, warm photograph (iced coffee with a logo sticker and a glazed madeleine on a wooden counter, burgundy tiles behind) fills a rounded-corner frame inset 20px from every edge on a cream page; the subject sits right of centre. In the left column, starting 42% down: a small star-rating line, then a three-line uppercase headline at 5vw in a heavy geometric sans, the first two lines outline-only and the third solid cream, a three-line paragraph, and a row with a pink pill button and an underlined text link. Top-left: menu icon and script logo. Top-right: a three-language pill toggle. Bottom-right: a circular text badge.
references.type: Dazzle, a heavy geometric uppercase, for headlines at 72px, used both solid and as an outline stroke; Cottorway, a slightly wide geometric sans, for 14px body and for a light italic accent word. A brush-script logo. Tracked capitals near 10px for labels.
references.colour: #f6efe6 #3d0012 #5c0a23 #ff99d3 #160b0a #e8a530 — Cream and deep burgundy alternate by section across wavy boundaries. Bubblegum pink is reserved for buttons, the active filter pill and carousel arrows; the product cut-outs supply every other colour.
references.imagery: A moody warm-graded hero photo; individual madeleines shot from above and cut out with soft shadows as small menu thumbnails; white line drawings (dog in beret, cafe table); rounded photo cards stacked at a tilt; a map redrawn in burgundy.
references.layout: Centred intro, a left-anchored story block on burgundy, then a two-column menu inside a container about 60% of the width. Section edges are curved waves rather than straight lines. Rounded frames and a sticky header with filter pills recur throughout.

sections.description: Cream field, everything centred. A tiny tracked-capitals label flanked by two short rules, then a two-line heading: the first line outlined uppercase in burgundy at about 4.5vw, the second a lowercase light italic of the body sans, solid. Three short paragraphs at 13px follow in a column about 45% wide. The section ends in a burgundy wave rising from the bottom, with a white line-drawn dog perched on the curve.

Burgundy field patterned with a faint tone-on-tone repeat of the logo. Left: a white line illustration, a three-line paragraph with bold phrases, two round pink arrow buttons and a slide counter. Right: a stack of portrait photo cards with rounded corners, the top one tilted a few degrees and the others fanned behind it. The bottom edge curves back to cream.

A sticky row of three pill filters beside the logo, the active one filled pink. Each category has an outlined uppercase label at left, an item count at far right and a hairline beneath. Items run in two columns: a 60px cut-out madeleine at left, then a bold uppercase name and a two-to-three-line italic description; some carry a tiny best-seller note or a pink allergen tag. No prices and no boxes.

Deep burgundy. The left two-thirds is an interactive map restyled entirely in burgundy and pink with rounded corners, the script logo as its pin and a small address card overlaid bottom-left. The right third is a rounded outlined panel listing opening hours, phone and email under tiny capital labels, plus two social icons. The script logo, large and white, is centred below, followed by a tracked-capitals legal line.

steal: Set a headline with its first lines as outline strokes and the last line solid, so emphasis falls on the final phrase without a size change.
Replace the stock map with one restyled in the brand's two colours and use the logo as the pin.
Build the menu from small cut-out product photos beside bold names and italic notes in two columns, with no cards.
